customManagers.description: Version pins marked with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above: Emscripten in build.yml and the Makefile. Mesa is a separate manager so its archive SHA-256 moves with the version.
Mesa version and the SHA-256 of mesa3d-<version>-release-msvc.7z. github-release-attachments identifies that asset from the current digest and hashes the same name on the new release.
Emscripten versions quoted in the manuals and comments, kept equal to the CI pin (make docs-drift checks this)

raylib source pin: the tag, its commit and the archive URL built from that commit are rewritten together (tools/build_raylib.py refuses a manifest where they disagree). The sha256 and patches.json need a manual update, so CI fails until a maintainer finishes the bump.
Vendored tomlc17 release. Renovate cannot re-import the sources and re-apply the project patches, so this only reports new releases on the Dependency Dashboard (see vendor/tomlc17/README.md).

packageRules.description: Toolchain and vendored-source pins change generated code or still need a maintainer to finish them (raylib's checksum and patches), so they are never automerged
One pull request for every Emscripten pin and mention
Mesa's archive SHA-256 is updated with the version by github-release-attachments
prBodyNotes: MESA_SHA256 is the SHA-256 of mesa3d-<version>-release-msvc.7z and is updated with the version.

packageRules.description: raylib bumps need a new SHA-256 in vendor/raylib/manifest.json; CI fails closed until it is updated
prBodyNotes: Update the pinned SHA-256 for the new archive before merging; the checksum check in CI fails until then.

packageRules.description: tomlc17 is vendored with project patches: report new releases on the Dependency Dashboard only
